interface.longDescription: Plan and operate a privately hosted NEXUS Agentic OS development instance. Guides separate project registration, bounded agent runs and approval review, secure server-side integration, and readiness checks. Bundles a small optional CLI for invoking an existing authorized NEXUS endpoint when the host provides Python and network access. No server, model, or NEXUS account is included; the plugin cannot connect without your own running instance and securely configured project key. NEXUS v0.1 is a development starter, not a live coding, repository editing, deployment, or web-research service.
capabilities: Plan isolated NEXUS projects and tool permissions
Run and inspect existing NEXUS agent tasks when connected
Design server-side Lucio and Ember integration
Audit development readiness and tenant isolation
defaultPrompt: Help me configure separate NEXUS projects for Lucio and Ember.
Inspect my NEXUS run and explain any pending approvals.
Plan and test a secure NEXUS adapter for my app.

name: nexus-agentic-os
description: Scoped project setup, agent-run operation, approval review and integration guidance for private NEXUS Agentic OS.
